question: What transformation is promised to one who goes at night to a crossroads?
premises: Going at night to crossroads yields khechara status.
The goddess is addressed as witness to this result.
inference: The verse promises khechara attainment through nocturnal crossroads practice.
uncertainties: The exact ritual context of khechara is not specified in this verse.
plain_english: O goddess, one becomes a sky-goer by going at night to a crossroads.
